# fulfilmentcrowd

fulfilmentcrowd is a Transportation, Logistics, Supply Chain and Storage company. fulfilmentcrowd is a global eCommerce fulfillment company that offers services for scaling across markets and channels. They provide services such as managing b2b & dtc, selling across every channel, scale internationally, and growing brands globally. They also offer a switchfulfilment partner to simplify operations and make scaling simple. Fulfilmentcrowd employs 101 people (+8.6% YoY, +8 people) and has an annual revenue of $17.5M, founded in 1993. Headquartered in Chorley, Lancashire, United Kingdom, with offices in Leyland St. Ambrose Ward and Western Avenue. Its workforce is distributed across United Kingdom and Netherlands.

## About

At fulfilmentcrowd, we specialise in rapidly deploying custom solutions for high-growth omnichannel brands. With fulfilment centres strategically located across the UK, EU, US and AU, we are your ideal partner for international growth.

Our high-volume centres process and ship over one million parcels annually. The award-winning fulfilmentcrowd platform empowers our clients and gives full control over their eCommerce activities.

Choose fulfilmentcrowd for seamless, scalable, and efficient fulfilment services that drive your global success.
